sentences.text: Iraq -LRB- -LSB- ɪˈræk -RSB- , -LSB- ɪˈrɑːk -RSB- , or -LSB- aɪˈræk -RSB- العراق ; عێراق -RRB- , officially known as the Republic of Iraq is a country in Western Asia , bordered by Turkey to the north , Iran to the east , Kuwait to the southeast , Saudi Arabia to the south , Jordan to the southwest , and Syria to the west .	Western Asia	Western Asia	Turkey	Turkey	Iran	Iran	Kuwait	Kuwait	Saudi Arabia	Saudi Arabia	Jordan	Jordan	Syria	Syria
The capital , and largest city , is Baghdad .	Baghdad	Baghdad

The main ethnic groups are Arabs and Kurds ; others include Assyrians , Turkmen , Shabakis , Yazidis , Armenians , Mandeans , Circassians , and Kawliya .	Arabs	Arabs	Kurds	Kurds	Assyrians	Assyrian people	Turkmen	Iraqi Turkmens	Shabakis	Shabak people	Yazidis	Yazidis	Armenians	Armenians in Iraq	Mandeans	Mandeans	Circassians	Circassians in Iraq	Kawliya	Kawliya

Around 95 % of the country 's 36 million citizens are Muslims , with Christianity , Yarsan , Yezidism , and Mandeanism also present .	Muslims	Muslims	Christianity	Christianity	Yarsan	Yarsan	Yezidism	Yezidism	Mandeanism	Mandeanism
The official languages of Iraq are Arabic and Kurdish .	Arabic	Arabic	Kurdish	Kurdish languages

Iraq has a coastline measuring 58 km on the northern Persian Gulf and encompasses the Mesopotamian Alluvial Plain , the northwestern end of the Zagros mountain range , and the eastern part of the Syrian Desert .	Persian Gulf	Persian Gulf	Mesopotamian Alluvial Plain	Tigris–Euphrates river system	Zagros mountain range	Zagros Mountains	Syrian Desert	Syrian Desert

Two major rivers , the Tigris and Euphrates , run south through Iraq and into the Shatt al-Arab near the Persian Gulf .	Persian Gulf	Persian Gulf	Tigris	Tigris	Euphrates	Euphrates	Shatt al-Arab	Shatt al-Arab
These rivers provide Iraq with significant amounts of fertile land .

The region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers , historically known as Mesopotamia , is often referred to as the cradle of civilisation .	Tigris	Tigris	Euphrates	Euphrates	between the Tigris and Euphrates	Tigris–Euphrates river system	Mesopotamia	Mesopotamia	cradle of civilisation	cradle of civilisation
It was here that mankind first began to read , write , create laws , and live in cities under an organised government -- notably Uruk , from which `` Iraq '' is derived .	Uruk	Uruk
The area has been home to successive civilisations since the 6th millennium BC .	6th millennium BC	6th millennium BC

Iraq was the centre of the Akkadian , Sumerian , Assyrian , and Babylonian empires .	Akkadian	Akkadian Empire	Sumerian	Neo-Sumerian Empire	Assyrian	Neo-Assyrian Empire	Babylonian	Neo-Babylonian Empire

It was also part of the Median , Achaemenid , Hellenistic , Parthian , Sassanid , Roman , Rashidun , Umayyad , Abbasid , Ayyubid , Mongol , Safavid , Afsharid , and Ottoman empires .	Median	Median Empire	Achaemenid	Achaemenid Assyria	Hellenistic	Seleucid Empire	Parthian	Arsacid Empire	Sassanid	Sassanid Empire	Roman	Roman Empire	Rashidun	Rashidun Caliphate	Umayyad	Umayyad Caliphate	Abbasid	Abbasid Caliphate	Ayyubid	Ayyubid dynasty	Mongol	Ilkhanate	Safavid	Safavid Empire	Afsharid	Afsharid dynasty	Ottoman	Ottoman Empire

Iraq 's modern borders were mostly demarcated in 1920 by the League of Nations when the Ottoman Empire was divided by the Treaty of Sèvres .	Ottoman	Ottoman Empire	League of Nations	League of Nations	Treaty of Sèvres	Treaty of Sèvres

Iraq was placed under the authority of the United Kingdom as the British Mandate of Mesopotamia .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	Kingdom	Kingdom of Iraq	Mesopotamia	Mesopotamia	British Mandate of Mesopotamia	British Mandate for Mesopotamia (legal instrument)
A monarchy was established in 1921 and the Kingdom of Iraq gained independence from Britain in 1932 .	Kingdom	Kingdom of Iraq	Kingdom of Iraq	Kingdom of Iraq
In 1958 , the monarchy was overthrown and the Iraqi Republic created .
Iraq was controlled by the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party from 1968 until 2003 .	controlled by	Ba'athist Iraq	Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party	Ba'ath Party (Iraqi-dominated faction)

After an invasion by the United States and its allies in 2003 , Saddam Hussein 's Ba'ath Party was removed from power and multi-party parliamentary elections were held in 2005 .	parliamentary	Parliamentary system	an invasion	2003 invasion of Iraq	its allies	Multi-National Force – Iraq	Saddam Hussein	Saddam Hussein	parliamentary elections were held in 2005	Iraqi parliamentary election, December 2005

The American presence in Iraq ended in 2011 , but the Iraqi insurgency continued and intensified as fighters from the Syrian Civil War spilled into the country .	American presence in Iraq	Iraq War	Iraqi insurgency	Iraqi insurgency (2011–13)	Syrian Civil War	Syrian Civil War
